items.title: Samaya AI Releases Sterling: A 3B-Active Finance Research Agent Model that Beats Claude Fable 5.1 on FrontierFinance at 11x Lower Cost
items.summary: Samaya AI’s Sterling is a post-trained Nemotron 3.5 Lightning model for financial research. It scores 58.9% on FrontierFinance at $0.61 per question, beating Claude Fable 5.1’s 55.9% at $6.89. The post Samaya AI Releases Sterling: A 3B-Active Finance Research Agent Model that Beats Claude Fable 5.1 on FrontierFinance at 11x Lower Cost appeared first on MarkTechPost.

items.title: Edge0 Releases Audio8-TTS-Realistic, a 0.6B Voice Cloning TTS Model
items.summary: Edge0 released Audio8-TTS-Realistic, a 0.6B open-weight zero-shot voice cloning TTS model under Apache 2.0. It supports 23 languages and adds a final GRPO stage driven by a learned realism critic. The post Edge0 Releases Audio8-TTS-Realistic, a 0.6B Voice Cloning TTS Model appeared first on MarkTechPost.

items.title: Baseten Releases joey-1, a 2B Decision Model at $0.01 per 1M Tokens
items.summary: Baseten has released joey-1, a 2B open-weight decision model that returns calibrated probabilities instead of text. It runs at 20 ms P50 latency and costs $0.01 per million input tokens. The post Baseten Releases joey-1, a 2B Decision Model at $0.01 per 1M Tokens appeared first on MarkTechPost.

items.title: Prime Intellect Releases Prime Mega MoE: Trainable Fused MoE Kernel, 3.11x Faster Forward Pass
items.summary: Prime Intellect released Prime Mega MoE, a backward pass for DeepSeek’s fused Mega MoE kernel. It makes the kernel trainable and speeds Qwen3 MoE training steps by up to 34% in prime-rl. The post Prime Intellect Releases Prime Mega MoE: Trainable Fused MoE Kernel, 3.11x Faster Forward Pass appeared first on MarkTechPost.

items.title: Infini-AI-Lab Releases Hermit, an Open-Source Harness Adapter Framework for AI Agents
items.summary: Infini-AI-Lab released Hermit, an Apache-2.0 harness adapter framework that trains an external layer of instructions, skills, memory and tools from task feedback, leaving the agent’s model and harness unchanged. The post Infini-AI-Lab Releases Hermit, an Open-Source Harness Adapter Framework for AI Agents appeared first on MarkTechPost.

items.title: Block Unveils Dessa, a Full-Duplex Speech Model Trained Only on Speech
items.summary: Block’s AI lab released Dessa, a full-duplex speech-to-speech model trained only on human conversation audio. It runs locally on a MacBook Pro M4 Max, but Block has published no size, benchmarks or weights. The post Block Unveils Dessa, a Full-Duplex Speech Model Trained Only on Speech appeared first on MarkTechPost.

items.title: AssemblyAI Ships AssemblyAI-TTS-1: A $15 per 1M Character Text-to-Speech API for Voice Agents
items.summary: AssemblyAI has released AssemblyAI-TTS-1, its first text-to-speech model for voice agents. It costs $15 per 1M characters, offers unlimited concurrency without a contract, and supports 6 languages at launch. The post AssemblyAI Ships AssemblyAI-TTS-1: A $15 per 1M Character Text-to-Speech API for Voice Agents appeared first on MarkTechPost.

items.title: NVIDIA Releases Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe: An Open 30B MoE Model for 40-Language Transcription with ~4B Active Parameters
items.summary: NVIDIA released Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe, an open-weights speech LLM with 4.3B active parameters. It transcribes 40 languages, adds speaker labels and word timestamps, and posts a 4.71% mean WER on the English Open ASR Leaderboard. The post NVIDIA Releases Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe: An Open 30B MoE Model for 40-Language Transcription with ~4B Active Parameters appeared first on MarkTechPost.

items.title: Google DeepMind Introduces Gemini 4 Carbon, Its Top Model for Cyber Defense and Coding
items.summary: Google DeepMind introduced Gemini 4 Carbon, a frontier model that scores 59 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index and 88.2% on SEC-bench Pro. Access starts with vetted cyber defenders, at $2/$10 per million tokens. The post Google DeepMind Introduces Gemini 4 Carbon, Its Top Model for Cyber Defense and Coding appeared first on MarkTechPost.

items.title: MiniMax Open-Sources MCode Stack: 15 Agent Skills Its Coding Team Uses Daily
items.summary: MiniMax has open-sourced MCode Stack, an MIT-licensed repo of 17 SKILL.md skills and 5 checklists that its MiniMax Code team uses daily for code review, subagent splits, context budgets and long-running commands. The post MiniMax Open-Sources MCode Stack: 15 Agent Skills Its Coding Team Uses Daily appeared first on MarkTechPost.
